The '''''Twi'lek Dancer''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class freighter]] that had a number of owners through the years.

Originally known as the '''''Harvest''''' it was owned by an [[agricultural combine]]. The ship was later re-named the '''''Venom Sting''''', customized and used by the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Xufal D'uat]] until his death. The ship was then salvaged by a [[Mining station/Legends|mining station]] and sold to a cell of [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]], who renamed it '''''Twi'lek Dancer''''', re-customized it and used it in their raids. The ship was then requised by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and sold to a legitimate trader of used ships.

==History==
[[File:Barloz-class_Medium_Freighter.png|thumb|left|200px|A ''Barloz''-class freighter like the ''Twi'lek Dancer'' (not pictured).]]
This [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class freighter]] built by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] was originally bought by an [[agricultural combine]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. The owners called the ship ''Harvest'' and used it for a time, until they earned enough money to buy an [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. They decided to sell the ''Harvest'' at this point.<ref name="ss" />

The ''Harvest'' was bought by [[Xufal D'uat]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] of [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] species. D'uat re-named the ship ''Venom Sting'' and performed several modifications first on a limited scope and later covering the whole ship, allowing him to fight any intrusion in his headquarters.<ref name="ss" />

For three years, D'uat operated the ''Venom Sting'' near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. During this time, he found an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer, [[Hamaz]], who also worked as a gunrunner for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. D'uat [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorded]] a confession from Hamaz and let him go, which allowed the Tiss'shar to blackmail Hamaz. However, this also earned D'uat an enemy: Hamaz arranged D'uat's successful murder.<ref name="ss" />

After D'uat's death, the ''Venom Sting'' drifted in space, with the holorecording safely hidden behind the [[autochef]] power system in an access panel in the galley. The ship was eventually recovered by a mining station affiliated to [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]<ref name="ss" />

The ''Venom Sting'' was then auctioned and bought by a cell of [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]], who re-named the ship ''Twi'lek Dancer.'' After discovering D'uat's customizations, the slavers used the ''Dancer'' as a picket defense ship and assault gunboat in their raids. They also improved sublight engines and shielding systems, and they added three proton torpedo launchers and one tractor beam.<ref name="ss" />

Eventually, the slavers were jumped by some [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who requised the ''Dancer'' and, using a false enterprise, sold it to a dealer in used ship.<ref name="ss" />

A holojournalist and former slave, mistakenly believing that the ''Dancer'' was still affiliated with the Thalassians, was trying to track the ship to expose the evil of its owners.<ref name="ss" />

==Modifications==
D'uat performed several modifications to the ship, commonly starting in only a part of it. For instance, he turned one of the cabins into a [[magna-seal]]ed cell with [[shock-filament]]s in the floor to administer [[stun charge]]s to his prisoners. The cell's life support was also filled with [[null gas]] canisters to knock down the prisoners. Those customizations were later applied to the whole ship.<ref name="ss" />

D'uat also added specialized technology to detect any intruder in his ship, interior defense system, an onboard fire-fighting matrix and a long-range communication array allowing him to see movement and thermal readings on his ship. He also had a hidden compartment behind an small access panel, behind the autochef power system, in the galley; D'uat used it to hide a holorecording allowing him to blackmail Hamaz. No further owner of the ship found this at least until the legitimate dealer with whom the pirates dealt.<ref name="ss" />

The Thalassian slavers improved the sublight speed and the shields, as well as adding three torpedo launchers and one tractor beam.<ref name="ss" />
